$comment: C16 TARGET DESCRIPTOR — the complete definition of the closure targets.
PROVENANCE. Every field below is derived from a declaration that exists in this
repository, never from the machine that happens to run the gate:
the declared build and release runtime for Phase 0.
importers     <- pnpm-workspace.yaml `packages:` globs, resolved to the exact
HONEST LIMITATION, recorded rather than papered over: Phase 0 ships no container
or deployment artifact for the application itself (there is no Dockerfile for
apps/api or apps/web; docker-compose only provides Postgres and Redis for local
development). The production target below is therefore the DECLARED release
runtime, not an observed deployed image. When a deployment artifact exists, this
descriptor must be re-derived from it and the closures regenerated.

production.description: Deployable runtime closure: the dependencies a running service needs.

development.description: Complete build/test/tooling closure across every workspace importer.

platform_filter_rules.semantics: A package is EXCLUDED only when its own recorded os/cpu/libc conditions are incompatible with the target. Negations (!win32) are honoured. MISSING METADATA MEANS INCLUDE — absence of a constraint is not evidence of incompatibility.

first_party_component_types.$comment: GOVERNED CycloneDX component type per first-party importer. Mapping every workspace to "application" is wrong: apps/api and apps/web are deployable applications, while packages/contracts and packages/tokens are libraries consumed by them. A consumer filtering the BOM for deployable units must not receive libraries.

integrity_rules.$comment: A REGISTRY package with no verifiable SRI digest is an unverified input to a gate whose purpose is verifying inputs, so it is rejected unless an explicit rule below states why integrity is unavailable for that resolution class. First-party workspace components are built from tracked source rather than fetched as artifacts, so they are outside this requirement by construction, not by exemption.
integrity_rules.note: Empty: every registry resolution in the current lockfile carries a valid sha512 SRI.
